history.summary: Refs register on the scope root `$refs` reads: a module WeakMap `scopeRoots` (scope → root element), filled by initScope, getStrayScope (body) and each l-for row scope (inherits its parent's root). handleRef resolves through it before falling back to findScopeRoot, so refs inside l-if clones, l-for rows, l-teleport and stray elements are no longer stranded on the clone/element. Refs are now reactive: __faqirRefs is created on first read and written through reactive(), so effects reading $refs.x re-run when it appears or goes; l-for is last-row-wins, cleared when that row goes. +~30 B gzip. Six regressions in runtime-fixes.test.ts. Session also fixed a red baseline: the v1.1.1 release left SKILL.md's CDN pin and site/lib/faqir-audit.js's version at 1.1.0 (588c30e).

Property-aware bindings: engine helper writeProp (writes only when different; checked/selected dispatch a bubbling faqir:model, never a native change); handleBind sets the property for checked/selected/muted/indeterminate/value, and handleModel routes its switch/checkbox/radio/select writes through it. toggle-group re-syncs on faqir:model and form reset without faqir:change (listeners removed in destroy); manifest 1.1.1. l-model tests moved off Faqir.start() into a container. +0.41 KB gzip. Session also rebuilt the Bun-pinned artifacts: this machine's 1.4.2 fails check:audit-browser/CDN-pin tests, so the suite was run with Bun 1.3.8 first on PATH.

Inserted content starts its controllers before l-init / first l-effect. l-if and l-for render through renderThenInit: l-init (handleInit and initScope's) and l-effect's first run go through runInit into a module-level pendingInits queue while a structural render is open; after insertion the inserted nodes' controllers start (connected nodes only) and the queue flushes, untracked. Nested renders join the outermost. Faqir.initTree starts a connected root's controllers first; the observer calls startControllers(node) before initTree. Bootstrap/observer sweeps share startControllers. README + @ui:directive l-init line state the order. +80 B gzip. Six regressions in runtime-fixes.test.ts. Follow-up 1.1F-36 (l-teleport inside inserted content; root l-init ordering asymmetry).

`:style` / `:class` merge instead of replace. handleBind keeps `prev` (what its last run set) per binding and removes only keys it set and has since dropped. styleMap normalises a string (via a detached element's CSSOM: custom properties, !important, shorthands), an object (`--customProps` no longer lowercased) or an array (now honoured), and applies them with setProperty(k, v, priority). classMap diffs `:class` tokens the same way; a falsy object entry still removes a markup class. Static style/class, l-show's display and controller writes now survive re-runs. New dev diagnostic `style` (`:style` declares display beside l-show) in dev-diagnostics.js, faqir-core.d.ts and docs/devtools.md (which also gained the missing `key` row). +0.17 KB gzip (45.15/46). Seven tests in faqir-core.test.ts (one production-silent), two in dev-build.test.ts. happy-dom trap refined: a static class/style breaks only when it precedes its binding.

Methods keep their component's `this` when called from a row. createScopeWithMagics binds every own writable function-valued data property to the reactive scope (written to the target, nothing triggers). Getters keep their receiver; late-assigned functions stay unbound (documented on the l-data directive line). snapshotValue strips `bound `, so inspect() is unchanged. New dev class `shadow` (devHooks.loopShadow, from a dev-marked line in handleFor): an author-written loop variable or index that shadows a scope name, once per list and name; d.ts, devtools.md and the 8-class count test updated. +0.06 KB gzip (45.50/46 under the pinned Bun). Four regressions in runtime-fixes.test.ts (incl. apiSource load() from a row named `items`), one in inspect.test.ts, two in dev-build.test.ts. Session first fixed a red baseline (3492d2c): faqir-mask.js was 2049/2048 B under Bun 1.3.8.

`$this` magic: the compiled expression/statement function gains a third parameter `$this`, and evaluate/evaluateAssignment call fn.call(scope, scope, el, el). It is the directive element in handlers, the root in l-data and a root's l-init, the <template> in l-for's list and l-key expressions. The `$el` parameter stays (top-level l-data still reads it). Faqir.magic('this') throws. @ui:magic line + gen:skill; Magics type, README, security.md, devtools.md. Five tests in faqir-core.test.ts. +0.05 KB gzip (45.55/46).

Engine injects no l-cloak <style>: injectCloakStyle and its bootstrap call removed; the [l-cloak] rule already ships in base/reset.css, so style-src 'self' is enough with no hash or 'unsafe-inline'. security.md §2/summary/§1 policy, the README policy and the generated context (context.ts security.csp) rewritten to match; @ui:directive l-cloak names reset.css (gen:skill). Tests: no style injection in engine, reset.css rule, doc never demands 'unsafe-inline', README policy == doc policy, context style_src, lifecycle 'uncloaks without injecting'; auto-start stub now detects boot via querySelectorAll. Engine+controllers 45.55 → 45.48 KB gzip.

Overlay focus. dialog/drawer/sheet (and alert-dialog via createDialog) give the panel tabindex="-1" at init when it has none (also in the canonical HTML), so panel.focus() on open lands and the trap and Escape work. Focus returns through a shared returnFocus(root, target, active) in registry/core/focus.js, mirrored in engine.js's focus section: active is read in onEnd before the panel hides, and focus goes back only if it is still on body or inside the overlay, and only to a connected opener not under [hidden]. command-palette's close uses the same helper. dialog/drawer/sheet CSS: `> [data-part=panel]:focus { outline: none }` (not the plan's :focus:not(:focus-visible), which misses the keyboard-open case); alert-dialog.css left alone (contrast.test ring gate, fallback-only target). Manifests 1.0.1 (cp 1.1.1) with required_attrs/notes/changes; gen:skill. Seventeen tests in overlay-family.test.ts § 4, eleven red on the old code. Engine+controllers 45.48 → 45.56 KB gzip.

Table roving Tab stop never strands. setupNavigability drops activeCell (to -1) when its row is not in navMatrix() (removed, filtered, group/tree-collapsed) or its column is hidden, gives hidden-column cells -1, and falls back to the first visible cell; it now also runs at the end of applyFilters, toggleGroup, toggleRow and setColumnHidden. Focus is never moved. table manifest 3.1.1. Seven tests in table-advanced.test.ts (six fail on the old controller). +40 B gzip (45.60/46).

Command palette Cmd/Ctrl+K: matched case-insensitively with a KeyK fallback for non-Latin layouts; ignores Alt, Shift (D3), repeat and IME composition; one owner per press (stands down on defaultPrevented, prevents when it acts, and a detached palette never claims it); new data-no-shortcut prop (noShortcut, read live) on two of the three example palettes; undo-history note. command-palette manifest 1.2.0, typed noShortcut in React/Vue bindings. Twelve tests (eight fail on the old controller). +90 B gzip (45.69/46).

Sidebar trigger glyph follows the state: sidebar.css mirrors `[data-part="trigger"] > :is(svg,[data-ui="icon"])` with `scale: -1 1` in rail (transition + reduced-motion fallback); both canonical examples use the left chevron and one stable aria-label "Toggle sidebar" (APG: an aria-expanded button keeps its name). Manifest 1.1.1 (trigger slot description, a11y note, changes). sidebar.test.ts +4; new tests/browser/sidebar-rail.pw.ts reads computed scale in Chromium through a real click. All 48 sidebar visual cases match HEAD baselines locally. No controller change, no size change.

Nested components keep their own parts. New registry/core/dom.js owns(root, el)/ownParts(root, part): the nearest [data-ui] above a part, looking through layout primitives (stack, cluster, grid, container, surface, switcher, aspect-ratio), via one closest(:not(...)) selector mirrored in engine.js §6. tabs takes :scope > list > trigger and :scope > panel; accordion takes :scope > item and toggles only from an item’s own trigger; dialog/alert-dialog/drawer/sheet take overlay/panel as direct children and trigger/close/confirm/cancel by owner; sidebar triggers and context-menu target/menu by owner (entry 6: a footer dropdown no longer gets aria-expanded forced or rails the sidebar). Eight manifests bumped. New tests/recipes/nesting.test.ts (15 rows, 14 red on HEAD) + dom.test.ts +3. Budget: the packaged faqir-core.min.js test had only 50 B free at HEAD, not the 0.31 KB `size` shows. Engine §6 dropped five dead private helpers ($, create, delegate, once, waitForTransition) to fit. Engine+controllers 45.69 → 45.58 KB; packaged 46,961/47,104 B.

Nesting, controllers II. carousel: slides are the viewport's :scope > children; prev/next/status/dots/containers via ownParts; click matches own buttons by identity (a nested carousel counted as 4 slides and its buttons moved both). popover close and tooltip content via ownParts. table: mine(el) = nearest [data-ui='table'] is root, wrapping the 7 delegated listeners plus the tfoot and quick-filter lookups (a table in a detail row stole focus/Tab stop, arrows, double-toggled row-toggles, filtered the outer). Leaf widgets left as-is with reasons in the commit body. Packaged min.js 46,961 -> 47,015/47,104 B; carousel standalone 1535/1536 B. Manifests: carousel 1.1.1, popover 1.0.1, tooltip 1.0.1, table 3.1.2. 6 new matrix rows, all red at HEAD.
